name: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot 'Salt'
story_html: As part of the Season 7 collection, the adidas Yeezy Desert Boot is equal parts style and function in a look driven by military inspiration. This edition—launched in September 2019—is constructed of breathable mesh, suede and nubuck in a Salt scheme. Its deconstructed design lines recall the iconic 500 sneaker. The shoe is mounted on top of a robust rubber outsole with a rugged tread pattern for durability and traction.
